messages.author: be5022d65f442ef6
messages.subject: Raptor count
parts:
I am trying to use transect made along roads in lowland farmland of NW
Italy in association with DISTANCE to estimate density of wintering
raptors.
I know only a similar published work (Andersen et al., 1985 - Wildl.
Soc. Bull.) instead of hundred roadside counts without measuring
perpendicular distance of raptors from transects.

Any suggestions of other published and unpublished works would be
welcome!
